units.source_text: 我担心稻草波雨水打湿，便用胸脯盖着稻草。

en.t: Worried that the straw would be soaked by the rain, I covered it with my chest.

units.source_text: 由于下雨，厕所的臭气更加浓烈，积淀在微风吹拂的羊齿草丛中……

en.t: Because of the rain, the stench from the toilet grew even stronger and settled among the fern thickets stirred by the light breeze...

units.source_text: 撒尿声止住，又传来了踉踉跄跄地将身子撞在板墙上的声音。

en.t: The sound of urinating stopped, and then came the sound of someone staggering and bumping his body against the plank wall.

units.source_text: 副司似乎又已迷蒙入梦。

en.t: The deputy priest seemed to have drifted back into a dazed sleep.

units.source_text: 映在窗上的灯火熄灭了。

en.t: The lamplight reflected in the window went out.

units.source_text: 我重新抱起三捆稻草，走到了大书院的后头。

en.t: I picked up the three bundles of straw again and went around to the back of the great study hall.
